context_loss_rule: Context loss is not authority to reconstruct accepted work.

compatibility_combinations.description: Recognize the original V1 lifecycle contract exactly as V1; no V2 adoption or migration is implied.
Recognize the V1 verification-only extension exactly; 1.2.0 does not supersede it by numeric ordering.
Recognize the V1 final-closure extension exactly; it does not retroactively replace the distinct 1.1.0 profile.
Explicit V2 compatibility composition over unchanged V1 lifecycle 1.0.0.
Explicit V2 compatibility composition over unchanged V1 verification-only lifecycle 1.1.0.
Explicit V2 compatibility composition over unchanged V1 final-closure lifecycle 1.2.0.

CONTINUE_V1.meaning: Remain a lawful V1 project; V2 tooling may read and validate the exact supported V1 profile without creating durable V2-only state.

V2_ADOPTION_OPTIONAL.meaning: The V1 project may continue unchanged, or the administrator may explicitly adopt the V2 compatibility/profile contract.

V2_ADOPTION_REQUIRED.meaning: A requested capability requires durable V2-only state; stop before that write until explicit administrator-approved V2 adoption and any separately authorized required migration.

V2_ADOPTION_DEFERRED.meaning: Adoption is possible but a prerequisite is not satisfied; continue only within the existing lawful V1 boundary.

UNSUPPORTED_INCOMPATIBLE.meaning: Observed profile is unknown, unsupported, contradictory, or cannot be resolved exactly; stop instead of guessing.

adoption_policy.rule: Continue under the exact recognized V1 contract without migration.
Adoption is explicit; reading V1 with V2 tooling is not adoption.
Stop before the V2-only write until explicit adoption and any required migration are separately authorized.
Preserve accepted V1 state and defer the V2-only capability.
Stop safely; never choose a schema by numeric version ordering.

accepted_state_semantics.COMMITTED_ACCEPTED_REPOSITORY_STATE: Primary accepted-state truth; authoritative until a lawful explicit revision or supersession is applied.
accepted_state_semantics.HISTORICAL_ACCEPTED_RECORDS: Immutable accepted lineage and dispositions; later profiles do not rewrite them retroactively.
accepted_state_semantics.CURRENT_OPERATIONAL_STATE: Current continuation state when it does not contradict a higher accepted record.
accepted_state_semantics.DRAFTS: Proposals only; existence never constitutes acceptance or authority.
accepted_state_semantics.EXPLICIT_ADMINISTRATOR_EVIDENCE: May authorize or accept an exact known action or artifact, but does not permit reconstruction of different accepted content and must be applied through the lawful lifecycle mechanism.
accepted_state_semantics.LIVE_REPOSITORY_EVIDENCE: May prove current Git or file facts, but observation alone does not prove administrator acceptance.
accepted_state_semantics.CONVERSATION_MEMORY: Advisory context only; never overrides repository-backed accepted state.

CLASS_A.description: Direct repository read, bounded repository write, command execution, and artifact transfer are technically available.

CLASS_B.description: Direct repository read and artifact transfer are technically available; repository mutations are administrator-applied and general local command execution is not available.

CLASS_C.description: No direct repository write or command execution is available; administrator-mediated commands or artifact transfer are required.

semantics: V2-04_IMPLEMENTED: source support now defines and validates the Continuity Overseer runtime record, paired accepted-origin linkage, and Project Orchestrator succession record family.
V2-04_IMPLEMENTED: Continuity Overseer may read repository-backed accepted roadmap, control, handoff, authorization, and evidence records; it is not the current-controller registry.
V2-04_IMPLEMENTED: authority-state fingerprint invariance and STALE_SUCCESSION_HANDOFF protect succession; repository-backed recovery succession never invents conversation-only facts.
V2-04_IMPLEMENTED: material project-goal or fundamental-scope conflict without a lawful accepted V2-03 revision surfaces SCOPE_DRIFT_REVIEW_REQUIRED.
Authority by existence remains false; repository-writer status by role remains false; automatic conversation creation, authority transfer, backfill, and migration remain forbidden.
After explicit administrator acceptance, the future Official Project Plan may become a planning baseline only.
Plan existence or acceptance does not grant implementation, migration, integration, tag, release, or repository-writer authority.
V2-01 defines authority semantics only; no V2-05 plan generator is implemented here.
